hook: Barcoding ribosomal DNA let researchers assemble all 18 nucleolar organizer regions of a human cell line

readout.label: Total rDNA units across 18 NORs in K562 cells

summary: These repeat-rich regions are the last parts of the human genome never fully assembled. The team used prime editing to insert short barcodes into nearly all rDNA units in K562 cells, then used ultra-long reads to assemble each region and count its copies (5 to 43 each). They also linked methylation to transcription for single units. It covers one cancer cell line, not a typical genome.
title: Saturation barcoding of ribosomal DNA resolves the nucleolar organizer regions of the human genome
